params.textField:
A neuraminidase inhibitor that prevents the virus particles to exit host cells and is probably most effective as a prophylactic is *Oseltamivir (suffix: …amivir)*

*Acyclovir and other …cyclovir medications like famciclovir and valacyclovir* are effective in the treatment of herpes viral infections like Herpes simplex I and II, varicella-zoster virus (chicken pox and later shingles) and Epstein Barr virus. They have been proven to decrease infection time and severity if taken as soon as symptoms occur

*Triumeq which contains Dolutegravir (an Integrase inhibitor), and Abacavir and Lamivudine (Reverse-transcriptase inhibitors)*
May increase longevity and decrease risk of HIV infection to a partner
